explainer.heading: When hair is dry, strands rub against each other and break when combed
body: The outer layer of the hair wears down with heat, perms, colour and hard brushing. Hair turns rough and tangles easily, and most breakage happens while detangling wet hair.
Kerasilk Smooth contains dimethiconol and guar hydroxypropyltrimonium chloride. Both lightly coat the strand, so hair feels slippery and combs easily right after washing.

blocks.heading: Key ingredients
blocks.intro: Three plant extracts are printed on the tube. Glycerin, dimethiconol and guar come from the brand's ingredient image.
blocks.caption: Neither keratin nor silk appears among the key ingredients on the tube or the brand's image, despite the Kerasilk name. No concentrations are printed. The full INCI list is printed on the product packaging.

rows.name: Gleditsia Australis Fruit Extract (soap pod)
rows.role: Gentle cleansing. The brand says it nourishes hair to feel strong and smooth.

rows.name: Ocimum Tenuiflorum Extract (holy basil)
rows.role: The brand says it helps cleanse the scalp and ease discomfort.

rows.name: Glycerin
rows.role: Humectant; keeps hair softer and more elastic.

rows.name: Dimethiconol
rows.role: A silicone that forms a thin coating for shine and easier combing.

rows.name: Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride
rows.role: A guar-based conditioner that reduces tangles and static.

items.heading: Dry, frizzy, tangled hair with split ends
items.body: Exactly the group the brand has in mind. Hair is slippier and easier to detangle after washing.

items.heading: Permed, coloured or often blow-dried hair
items.body: The light coating makes strands feel less rough. You can add Collagen Deep Shot to the lengths and ends.

items.heading: Oily scalp, fine hair that falls flat
items.body: Hair may feel heavier. Hair Boost suits a scalp that gets oily fast.

items.heading: An irritated or scratched scalp
items.body: Wait until the scalp has settled. Stop if it stings or turns red.

items.heading: Wet all of the hair and scalp
Lather and spread
items.body: Take enough into your palm, add a little water to lather, and spread evenly through the hair.

items.heading: Massage the scalp for 2–3 minutes
items.body: Use the fingertips, not the nails.

items.heading: Rinse thoroughly
items.body: Rinse with clean water until no foam is left.

items.q: Does the Kerasilk name mean it contains keratin and silk?
items.a: Neither keratin nor silk is listed on the tube or in the brand's ingredient image. The key ingredients listed are glycerin, soap pod, soapberry and holy basil extracts, plus dimethiconol and guar for smoother, easier-to-comb hair.

items.q: How is it different from Hair Boost?
items.a: Kerasilk Smooth is aimed at dry, frizzy, tangled hair that needs smoothing. Hair Boost is aimed at a scalp that gets oily fast and fine hair that breaks easily; its label lists Kopexil, Redensyl™ and caffeine.
Yes. Dimethiconol is a silicone; it forms a thin coating that makes hair smoother. If you need to avoid silicone, this one is not for you.
Close the cap after use, keep in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and out of reach of children.
